Strawberry Tiramisu Dessert:
By: Amreen Khan
Published: Thursday, October 7, 2010 - 5:54am

Ingredients




125 grams fresh cream,whipped
250 gm cream cheese
1/2 cup icing sugar
1/4 cup water
2 teaspoons coffee powder
1 cup strawberries
1 packet plain biscuits
1 teaspoon cocoa powder

Preparation

1 Beat cream cheese and sugar. Fold in the cream. 2 Combine water and coffee powder and keep aside. 3 In a serving dish, place the biscuits on the base and soak them with the coffee water. Top with cream cheese mixture. Add the strawberries and repeat these layers again. 4 Dust the top with cocoa powder and strawberries.
